description: v1 launch scripts — one per program category. Each script is a complete theta-state morning hypnotherapy session ready for ElevenLabs TTS. Use {{name}} as the personalization token (replaced with the user's first name at generation time).

voice_profile.style: Calm, measured, warm but authoritative. Guided meditation crossed with a confident coach. Not robotic. Not over-performed. Present. Slow enough to meet someone still half-asleep.

scripts.title: General Morning Mindset
scripts.description: A gentle, all-purpose morning session that builds presence and intention for the day.

scripts.title: High Performer Daily Activation
scripts.description: For ambitious users who want to start the day locked in and operating at peak.

scripts.title: Calm & Centered Start
scripts.description: A peaceful, grounding session for users who tend to wake up with a busy mind.

scripts.title: Deep Focus & Flow State
scripts.description: Primes the brain for deep work by setting a clear focus target and rehearsing distraction-free flow.

scripts.title: Quit Vaping / Nicotine
scripts.description: Reinforces nicotine cessation through craving awareness, breathing techniques, and identity reframing.

scripts.title: Reduce Anxiety
scripts.description: Calms the nervous system and teaches the user to observe anxious thoughts without following them.

scripts.title: Build Confidence
scripts.description: Rewires self-doubt by anchoring the user in evidence of their own capability.

scripts.title: Morning Prayer (Lord's Prayer)
scripts.description: Guided Christian morning prayer incorporating the Lord's Prayer and personal reflection.

scripts.title: Gratitude & Abundance Mindset
scripts.description: Shifts the brain from scarcity to abundance through specific gratitude practice and reframing.

scripts.title: Reduce Alcohol / Support Sobriety
scripts.description: Sobriety reinforcement through play-the-tape-forward visualization and identity-based habit change.

scripts.title: Improve Sleep Quality
scripts.description: Morning session that programs better sleep habits by setting circadian rhythm intentions for the day.

scripts.title: Build a Consistent Exercise Habit
scripts.description: Lowers the bar for daily movement and builds identity as someone who exercises consistently.

scripts.title: AA / Recovery Mantra
scripts.description: Recovery-focused session with the Serenity Prayer, sobriety affirmations, and one-day-at-a-time framing.

scripts.title: Stop Wasting Time on Social Media
scripts.description: Breaks the scroll reflex by building awareness of the attention gap and reclaiming screen-free presence.

scripts.title: Beat Procrastination
scripts.description: Reframes procrastination as a comfort reflex and teaches the five-minute start technique to break the seal.

scripts.title: Stop Eating Sugary Sweets
scripts.description: Rewires the sugar craving cycle by teaching pause-and-replace and visualizing stable, clean energy.

scripts.title: Quit Smoking
scripts.description: Reinforces smoking cessation through identity shift, craving surfing, and body-healing awareness.

scripts.title: Reduce Social Anxiety
scripts.description: Dismantles the imagined spotlight effect and builds confidence through small, intentional social engagement.
